include: Core Pyramid DYNAMIC and FIRST_CORE_CUMULATIVE anchor modes
Durable two-leg Overlap post-leg1 economic revalidation
Input consolidation with versioned compatibility migration
Vietnamese human-readable runtime journals and state logs
exclude: Forward/live approval before owner Strategy Tester evidence

hard_contracts: FIRST_CORE_CUMULATIVE anchor is immutable within the exact-Magic Core campaign and uses cumulative distance steps.
Recovery WAIT/NO_EFFECT does not consume the Strategy tick; only actual mutation/pending/reconcile consumes the mutation slot.
Same-side Recovery ownership blocks same-side Core Pyramid ADD; opposite-side WAIT does not starve the other side.
Overlap persists pair intent before leg1; after broker-confirmed leg1 it must re-read market/economics before leg2.
Unsafe post-leg1 leg2 remains durable WAIT; it is not force-closed negative.
Ambiguous broker result enters reconcile and is never blindly retried.
Hedge Pyramid staged coverage is total Recovery Hedge/current exact-Magic Core and is normalized to executable broker units.
Equivalent broker-volume coverage stages are deduplicated and their gaps remapped to effective stages.
Compatibility migration preserves a defined path for prior .set values and durable Recovery state.
Runtime user-facing logs are short Vietnamese messages explaining state/reason/error; internal enums may exist but must not be the only explanation.
One actual trade mutation chain per tick remains invariant.

rules: Prefer plain Vietnamese over internal jargon.
A WAIT line states what condition is missing and, where measurable, how much remains.
A BLOCK line states the exact gate that blocked the action.
An ERROR line states module, side, current state and fail-closed action.
State transitions log once; repeating waits use throttled heartbeat.
Keep ticket/lot/price/serial/generation when needed for audit reconstruction.

build_stages.name: Effective Hedge ladder and target semantics
Exact-head full verification and QA EX5

minimum_cases: Opposite-side Recovery WAIT does not starve qualified Pyramid
requested end date reached with no reconcile/no-money/stopout/balance bleed
